theme: reconstruct a torn tapestry woven from few thread patterns
title: The Conservator's Loom: Rank-Faithful Tapestry Restoration
strategies: zero-fill: leave every torn cell blank (0), feasible but ignores all structure
fixed-basis single-shot solve: express other rows as a combination of the first 3 matrix rows using whichever few columns they happen to share, no redundancy or corruption check

reference-row bilinear closure: detect the fully-intact rows, search candidate ranks by which one yields an invertible, high-consensus linear system, and fill torn cells with the consensus bilinear prediction (spike detection and completion as one computation)
